newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss bond trade closed for holiday August 1.
newsitem.headline: Swiss bond trade closed for holiday August 1.

text.p: 0715 GMT - Swiss bond trade was closed on Friday with banks and bourses shut for the Swiss August 1 national holiday. Trade will resume on Monday. Prices fell on Thursday.
* Sept Conf futures ended down 23 bp at 120.27.
* 4-1/2 pct June 2007 bond yielded 3.421 pct vs 3.398 pct -- Zurich Editorial, +41 1 631 7340
